# Transformer Resources & Guides

Expert guidance on selecting, specifying, and procuring transformers. Whether you're new to transformer procurement or a seasoned engineer, our resources help you make informed decisions.

[**Buyer's Guides** \\
\\
Step-by-step guides for selecting and specifying transformers](https://fluxco.com/resources#guides) [**Technical Resources** \\
\\
Deep dives into transformer specifications and standards](https://fluxco.com/resources#technical) [**Industry Insights** \\

Market trends, supply chain updates, and industry news](https://fluxco.com/resources#industry)

## Buyer's Guides

[Buyer's Guides10 min read\\
**FEOC Compliance for Transformer Buyers: What You Need to Know Before Your Next Purchase** \\
The Foreign Entity of Concern rules are reshaping transformer procurement. If your project claims clean energy tax credits, your transformer supply chain is now under the microscope.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/feoc-compliance-guide-transformer-buyers) [Buyer's Guides8 min read\\
**How to Choose the Right Distribution Transformer (Without Getting Burned)** \\
A complete buyer's guide to selecting distribution transformers. Learn about kVA sizing, voltage classes, cooling types - and why where it's made matters more than ever.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/how-to-choose-distribution-transformer) [Buyer's Guides12 min read\\
**Transformers 101: Every Type Explained (So You Don't Sound Clueless on Your Next Call)** \\
The complete guide to transformer types: padmount, pole-mount, substation, dry-type, autotransformers, and more. What they are, when to use them, and what they cost.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/transformer-types-explained) [Buyer's Guides6 min read\\
**RFPs to 5 Suppliers vs. One Search Across 150+: Why Smart Buyers Use a Marketplace** \\
Sending RFPs to a handful of OEMs is how transformer procurement has always worked. But it's slow, limited, and leaves money on the table. Here's why a marketplace approach gets better results.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/why-use-transformer-marketplace)

## Technical Resources

[Technical Resources7 min read\\
**Your Space Saving Solution: Integrated Fault Interrupting (IFI) Transformers** \\
Integrated fault interrupting transformers build primary-side protection and switching into the transformer itself, replacing a separate switchgear pad. How the design works, how it compares, and how to specify it so multiple manufacturers can bid.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/integrated-fault-interrupting-transformers) [Technical Resources6 min read\\
**Electricity Doesn't Travel Well. Transformers Are Why It Travels at All.** \\
We are bound by Ohm's law, and it is never changing. Without a step-up transformer, high power can't survive even a short trip. The physics, in one chart.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/transformers-short-distances) [Technical Resources7 min read\\
**DOE Transformer Efficiency Standards: Compliance, Competition, and China** \\
Complete guide to DOE transformer efficiency standards - and why these regulations matter more than ever for supply chain security.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/doe-transformer-efficiency-standards) [Technical Resources6 min read\\
**Transformer Cooling Classes Explained: ONAN, ONAF, OFAF, and More** \\
Understanding transformer cooling class designations. Learn what ONAN, ONAF, OFAF, and other cooling codes mean and how to select the right cooling for your application.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/transformer-cooling-classes-explained) [Technical Resources8 min read\\
**DOE 2029 Efficiency Mandates: The End of Cheap Foreign Transformers?** \\
New DOE efficiency standards take effect April 23, 2029. They raise the efficiency floor unevenly - modestly for most of the market, sharply for designs built to the old minimum - tightening supply and squeezing the cheapest imports.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/doe-2029-efficiency-standards-transformer-guide) [Technical Resources8 min read\\
**Amorphous Steel Cores: The Efficiency Secret Most Buyers Don't Know About** \\
Amorphous metal cores cut no-load losses by up to 70% compared to conventional silicon steel. With the DOE 2029 efficiency standards approaching, they matter to more transformer buyers than ever.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/amorphous-steel-core-transformers)

## Industry Insights

[Industry Insights7 min read\\
**Why Buying a Transformer Is So Damn Hard (And How to Make It Easier)** \\
The transformer market is fragmented - hundreds of suppliers, no centralized inventory, weeks for quotes. Here's why procurement is painful and how smart buyers navigate it.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/why-buying-transformers-is-so-difficult) [Industry Insights8 min read\\
**Is Your Transformer Really Made in America? How to Verify Before You Buy** \\
FEOC compliance is critical for tax credits, but 'Made in USA' claims can be confusing. Assembly vs. manufacturing, component sourcing, corporate ownership - here's how to verify what you're actually getting.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/is-your-transformer-really-made-in-america) [Industry Insights5 min read\\
**Transformer Lead Times in 2026: The Chickens Have Come Home to Roost** \\
Current transformer lead times and the real reason they're so long. Spoiler: America's dependence on foreign manufacturing created this mess.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/transformer-lead-times-2026) [Industry Insights6 min read\\
**Billions in Tax Credits for American Manufacturing - Are You Capturing Your Share?** \\
The Big Beautiful Bill rewards projects using domestically manufactured transformers. The bonus is huge. The rules are strict. And most developers are leaving money on the table.\\
Read article](https://fluxco.com/resources/big-beautiful-bill-tax-credits-transformers-domestic-content)
